HE REQUEST BODY and becomes visible to whatever makes the call. The response is metadata only. Creating a project-shared secret re
quires project admin; a personal one does not.\n- [Get a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/get-a-secret.md): O
ne secret's metadata: delivery mode, host binding, sharing, and when it was last handed to a run. Never its value. A secret from a
nother project (and another member's personal secret) both read as 404.\n- [Delete a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/secrets/delete-a-secret.md): Delete a stored credential. HARD: the row and the encrypted value both go, and MCPJam stops deliveri
ng it. Deliberately NOT blocked when an environment still selects it: refusing would leave a leaked credential undeletable until s
omeone edited every environment naming it, and deletion must never wai…\n- [Rotate or re-bind a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/ap
i-reference/secrets/rotate-or-re-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate the value and/or change how it is delivered. A rotation reaches NEW RUN
S ONLY: a session already running holds the old value (materialized in its box's environment, or inside an egress policy that cann
ot be read back) and there is no safe way to replace it mid-run.\n- [List a journey's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
swarm-runs/list-a-journeys-runs.md): Newest first. Compact records: `attempts` is on the single-run read.\n- [Launch a journey](ht
tps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/launch-a-journey.md): Answers **202**: the run row exists and its fan-out has start
ed. It is not finished. Poll `GET /projects/{projectId}/goal-runs/{runId}` until `status` leaves `running`.\n- [Get a journey run]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/get-a-journey-run.md): The full record, including per-session `attempts` and `ta
rgetSummaries`.\n- [List a run's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-runs-sessions.md): One entry pe
r chat session the run produced. Summaries, not transcripts. Read a transcript through the chat-session routes using `id`.\n- [Can
cel a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/cancel-a-journey-run.md): Accepts a durable Stop request and r
eturns immediately. cleanupPending indicates that attempts are being settled in the background; status remains the current stored
run status. IDEMPOTENT: cancelling an already-cancelled run answers 200 with `alreadyCanceled: true` and `finalized: 0`, not a 409
.\n- [Project swarm roll-up](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/project-swarm-roll-up.md): Recent runs with thei
r goal-completion rates and repeat-failure findings, plus a project-wide trend. Deterministic and free. Start here.\n- [Get a run'
s rubric scorecard](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-a-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The deterministic rubric
result for one run. No model, no spend.\n- [List swarm findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/list-swarm-
findings.md): Criteria that keep failing, tracked across waves. One finding is one problem OVER TIME: `occurrenceCount` and `statu
s` carry the history, so do not treat repeat appearances as separate problems.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/swarm-insights/dismiss-a-finding.md): Hides a finding from your view. ORTHOGONAL to `status`: dismissing does not claim
the problem stopped happening, and a dismissed finding that fires again stays `recurring`.\n- [Undismiss a finding](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/undismiss-a-finding.md): Reverses a dismissal. Bodyless, like its twin.\n- [Get swarm run i
nsights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-swarm-run-insights.md): Poll this after requesting insights. **4
04 means nobody asked**: it is deliberately not an empty `status: \"none\"` body, so a caller in a polling loop cannot mistake \"n
ever requested\" for \"asked and still working\".\n- [Request swarm run insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insi
ghts/request-swarm-run-insights.md): Answers **202**: generation is scheduled, not done. Poll the GET above rather than re-request
ing.\n- [Cancel a pending swarm-run-insights generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/cancel-a-pending-swa
rm-run-insights-generation.md): Stops a generation that is still `pending`. A swarm run with no generation in progress answers 409
: there is nothing to cancel, and reporting success would tell a caller it stopped something it did not.\n- [Request insights for
an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed**: the mo
del cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm an
d user-testing insights.\n- [Grade an eval run with LLM as Judge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-wi
th-llm-as-judge.md): **Spends.** Runs the goal-completion judge over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against it
s expected output.\n- [Start a Claude directory-readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-c
laude-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against Anthropic's connector-directory requirements and returns `202`
with a run id. The target comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a mod
el or a cost. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Deterministic grading is…\n- [Start an OpenAI plugin-directory readiness run](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-an-openai-plugin-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved serv
er against OpenAI's plugin-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. `submissionMode` is required and never inferred
: inferring it would read a forgotten package as `mcp-only` and report the package lane not-applicable, turning a missing input in
to a clean bill of…\n- [Start a Muse connector readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-mu
se-connector-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against Meta's Muse connector guidelines and returns `202` with a run id.
Free: Muse readiness has no AI observations, so the body has no field that can spend, and no submission mode, which belongs to the
OpenAI plugin directory. The submission-ready verdict stays `incomplete…\n- [List readiness runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/directory-readiness/list-readiness-runs.md)\n- [Read one readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-rea
diness/read-one-readiness-run.md): Lane statuses, coverage and the observation axis. The full report (every finding with its citat
ion and provenance) is a separate fetch.\n- [Cancel an in-flight readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-re
adiness/cancel-an-in-flight-readiness-run.md): The executing node learns about this on its next heartbeat and aborts the run in fl
ight, which matters more than the row's status: the thing being stopped is traffic to somebody else's server.\n- [Resume a stopped
readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/resume-a-stopped-readiness-run.md): Runs again a run tha
t stopped on the server before it finished, which the run detail reports as `resumable: true`. The server is graded with the calle
r's credentials, so only the person who started the run can resume it. The run keeps the inputs it started with, and the request h
as no body. Poll the…\n- [Fetch a readiness run's full report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/fetch-a-r
eadiness-runs-full-report.md): Every finding, with its class, provenance, publisher-documentation citation and remediation. AI-der
ived findings carry `provenance` of `llm` and are confined to the experience lane as `heuristic` or `manual-review`; they can neve
r decide a lane. `404` when the run has no stored report: it may be in…\n- [Start a persisted conformance run](https://docs.mcpjam
.com/api-reference/conformance-runs/start-a-persisted-conformance-run.md): Grades the saved server against the protocol, apps, and
tasks suites and returns `202` with a run id. The target comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL.
OAuth is not startable here. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Status, outcome, and score are three different an…\n- [List pers
